prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Conroe, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1233; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were involved in on a roadway in Conroe, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident details, if that's okay. I'm the driver of the vehicle that was hit from behind.

Q: That's fine. For the record, can you tell me how the collision happened?

A: I was stopped at a red light at an intersection. I had been stopped for maybe ten seconds when I felt a hard impact from behind. My head snapped back and my car got pushed forward into the crosswalk.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I saw headlights in my mirror a second before, but I didn't have time to react.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was. The belt locked up pretty hard when it hit.

Q: Did you receive any medical attention at the scene?

A: The paramedics came and checked me out. They asked about my knee because I'd hit it on the dashboard. I told them it hurt but I could still walk a little.

Q: Have you seen a doctor since then?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same day and then I had a follow-up with my primary doctor. They said the knee is badly bruised and there might be a ligament problem. I've got an MRI scheduled.

Q: Are you currently missing any work because of the injury?

A: I've been on light duty for a while. I can't stand for long periods, so I've been sitting more and it's been frustrating.

Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Just that I'm still dealing with the pain, and I want to make sure my medical bills get covered.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
